nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Light Gel Cream

avis.texte: I have combo oily skin and in the summer i usually use the neutrogena gel cream and its light but still hydrating. This however does not hydrate, i had to pair with a milky toner for added moisturizer.

avis.titre: Love how it goes perfectly with my morning routine!
avis.texte: It's lightweight but satisfyingly moisturizing, definitely restocking soon

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again!!!
avis.texte: Very great product, something Id buy again and again like I said. It helps my skin tremendously and makes it look flawless.
This is the perfect moisturizer if you are looking for something light weight and non-greasy. Especially if you have oily or combination skin.

My skin soaked it up right away. I healed my dry and cracked skin in like a week. It id SUPERRR lightweight. And best of all, its completely fungal acne safe so if you have fungal acne or not its amazing. It had really good ingredients and will really hydrate your skin.

avis.titre: Very nice soothing and moisturizing for a gel
avis.texte: I was sent this cream so I can give an honest review, pretty nice light application on skin, it doesnt feel heavy feels very light but makes my skin feel very hydrated, i love that from a gel product thats not really common with gel products. Would probably buy again very soothing and light.

In using this product for daytime over 2 weeks, I've noticed it is a great moisturizer for makeup prep. It absorbs nicely and works well with makeup. I didn't notice much pore minimizing. I would use this if you need a simple hydrating moisturizer. If someone needs more than normal hydration, they may find it too light.

avis.titre: Silky texture, not the best for dry skin
avis.texte: This is a lovely product, but unfortunately does not suit my dry skin with enough hydration. I use it more as a serum prior to moisturizing

I have been using this gel cream for à While and is i am sastified with the results. I have noticed great changes in my skin; it absorbs quickly, has minimized my pores and keeps my skin very hydrated. It doest'n leave any clumps has à lightweight, non-greasy texture, and is ideal for sensitive skin

avis.titre: I will buy this product again
avis.texte: I have been using this product for a month or so and I love it. This on top of my moisturizer make my face look so good and hydrated and my makeup perfect without using a primer. You don't need alot of product and it doesn't dry out as you're applying like other gel products. It goes on very light and smooth on its own or on top of other products. I don't notice any scent. I did receive this product in exchange for my review though.

At first, I thought I was not gonna like this cream, but it drags down very quick and nice. My skin had a very cute and subtle glow, and it didn't have any sandwich, which is something I look forward.
This product has been the missing piece for my skin care routine. I love how light weight their serum is. Also I love how my skin has respond to it also. Definitely noticing a difference in my pores.
I used the moisturizer as the last step of my skincare routine. It gives a none greasy great glow and works good under makeup
I've been using this under my makeup and it's fabulous. I think it makes my skin smoother and the makeup last all day. Would Def repurchase. Bonus points for being affordable.
This was first of all super easy to use. It was very cooling on my skin and it did seem to tighten my pores after one use. I like the texture and how it's more gel-like.

I received this product as part of a free sample program. Prior to using it, I had never used a gel cream, but I found it easy to incorporate into my nightly skincare routine. Although I have oily skin, I have found that this gel cream is not moisturizing enough for my skin on its own, so I layer it on top of a serum and under a cream moisturizer. It is incredibly lightweight, and a little bit goes a long way. I enjoy the cooling sensation and how quickly it absorbs into my skin. By using this product, I was hoping to minimize the pores on my nose and in the center of my cheeks. Since I began using it about a month ago, my pores look much tighter and less noticeable, especially under makeup. I love that this product gives my skin a smooth, porcelain-like finish on its own and that it has niacinamide to brighten my skin and control oil production. I would recommend this product to those who are looking to minimize and prevent large pores. I would also recommend it to those looking to fade dark spots. I will definitely purchase this product in the future.

I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review. I've always loved skin1004- it's perfect for my combination, sensitive, acne-prone skin. This moisturizer is super lightweight and plays so well under my other products. No pilling, absorbs quickly, and didn't irritate my acne. Overall great product, I'd recommend!!

This light cream gel was a very nice addition to my current skincare routine, the things I liked were that it was 1)Light weight and that it blended well with other creams without looking cake-y. 2) The gel consistency. 3) That my skin looked brighter. That being said, I believe this gel works better in the summer, during the winter month I prefer more moisturizing creams since my skin gets very dry. Also, I didn't feel a significant pore minimizing effect. I am excited to use this gel for the summer and am thankful to have received it from a free sampling program to provide a review.

avis.titre: Nice and light on the skin!
avis.texte: It feels so good on the skin! It's light and I've noted some small changes in my pores. I love how budget friendly it is!!

avis.titre: Put off Korean skincare for too long
avis.texte: I started using a Korean skincare product several months ago, and have acquired a few more since. Should have started sooner, and I wish I had found this gel cream sooner. It makes my skin so hydrated and soft. Likely to be part of my 'permanent' skincare collection I'm building. Feels so good on the skin.

I recieved this product for free from Centella in exchange for my honest review. This gel cream glides on smoothly and instantly absorbs into the skin. It leaves behind no tacky residue and feels so lightweight throughout the day. My skin felt hydrated and my pores were visibly minimized. Highly recommend!
It is very refreshing on the face and it hepa minimize my pores. It is hydrating and also helps make up have a good finish.

This centella gel cream is absolutely amazing. This is a unique texture, and it's different from typical "gel" or "water gel" moisturizer/cream products. This is a true gel. This delivers hydration and soothes the skin from redness and irritation, but absorbs so quick and looks great under makeup. If you have oily skin, this is perfect! I pair this with the centella serum, as well as the light cleansing oil to remove makeup and spf residue. I have acne prone skin, and never have once broken out from these products. I Absolutely love Skin1004, and their products are consistently curated with great ingredients and quality! They leave my skin glowing.
This products works great and leaves my skin soft after use, I have combination skin and was a bit worried it would not suit my skin type but it did and I'm glad I gave it a chance.

avis.titre: Great option for a lightweight cream!
avis.texte: To preface, I have really dry skin, so this being a lightweight I knew was not going to provide me with enough moisturization. I also haven't any pore minimizing as the product claims. That said, this was still pretty hydrating and does layer well with other skincare products. I think people of all skin types will appreciate this!

I use this moisturizer after washing my face in the morning. The product is a nice, lightweight gel. I think the moisturizer is great for the summer months if you have oily skin. I do not think it's moisturizing enough for the winter months. What I did not like about the product is that it leaves a film on your face for over 30 minutes before dissolving. This film does not have a moisturizing feel to it. I also did not see any differences with my pores. I would only recommend it if you have super oily skin and need something light and non-greasy to moisturize.

I've received this product for free to try as a sample, and so far I've been loving it! I've been looking for a moisturizer that works for my oily and acne prone skin and this product has been checking all the boxes. It's hydrating but not sticky or irritating

This moisturizer is very lightweight and spreads evenly. It can be a bit sticky upon application but it does dry down. I have combination skin and I found that this was too lightweight for my skin type. I'd say this is better suited for oily skin types. It is winter where I am so maybe this would be better in summer for me.

This moisturizer is mostly recommended for oily skin as it doesn't leave much of an occlusive layer and soaks in pretty quick. I have dry combo skin and I actually really like this product and use it all the time. It reminds me more of a gel or serum though, like the ordinary serum or the Neutrogena hydro boost. If you have dry skin you can use this and add another moisturizer on top when you need it. I have some sensory sensitivities related to autism and I don't like super occlusive products because it makes me feel weird so this product also helps with that. The Centella also helps calm down any breakouts or irritation.

avis.titre: Such a Refreshing, Cooling Gel — My Skin Loves This!
avis.texte: I received this for my honest review, and y'all… this gel feels so good on the skin. The moment I put it on, it had this light, cooling feeling that instantly made my face feel refreshed. It's super lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any sticky or greasy residue at all. My skin literally drank it up. It gave me that soft, hydrated look without feeling heavy, and it really helped calm my skin after cleansing. I also noticed my pores looked a little smoother, which was a nice surprise. This is meant to be the last step of your skincare routine! If you love moisturizers that feel clean, cooling, and easy on the skin, this one is such a win. I've honestly enjoyed using it way more than I expected. Highly recommend!
I received this product for free for testing services. This product is great for my oily skin. It plays well with my other skincare and makeup. It absorbs quickly and leaves a nice dewy base.

This moisturizer feels very lightweight and is soothing on the skin. I used this product in both a cold, dry climate and a very hot and humid climate, and I would definitely recommend it more for a humid climate. It stuck to some dry patches when I was in a dry and wintry area. I have combo-dry skin. I did have my friend try it out who has combo-oily skin, and she really liked it! I like how this moisturizer feels, so I'll stock it away until next summer.

I loved how this gel was so lightweight and hydrating. It absorbed into the skin quickly without leaving a sticky residue. It had a dewy look/finish and made my look glowy. I would def add to my rotation of skincare!

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I loved how lightweight this is and it has no scent. My skin is very sensitive and this worked perfectly. I love how to worked under makeup. My skin looks smooth and blurred every time I use it!
I like the cooling sensation the gel gives when applied to my face. It's lightweight but leaves my skin feeling refreshed and moisturized
Refreshing. light, and moisturizing - perfect for oily skin. Not heavy, absorbs fast, and skin feels nourished and looks better than ever! Get it - you won't be disappointed!

Skin1004 sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program. I should have looked more into the ingredients before accepting the product to try. I ran it through ingredient checkers and was not satisfied with the outcome. It has a potential pore clogger and potentially irritating ingredients. I tried it on my hands since my face is sensitive and it is lightweight.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin feeling so soft
avis.texte: This Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Light Gel Cream is lightweight with no fragrance. It leaves my skin feeling soft and layers well under makeup.

I love how lightweight the Madagascar Centella Poreminimizing Light Gel Cream feels on my skin while still giving me soothing hydration. The centella formula absorbs quickly and helps calm any redness without leaving a greasy finish. After using it consistently, I've noticed my skin texture looks smoother and my pores appear smaller. Overall, it's a gentle, refreshing moisturizer that really helps balance my skin.

I've been loving this gel cream! It's super lightweight, absorbs quickly, and gives a fresh feel without getting greasy. The texture is silky and cooling, perfect for anyone who wants moisture without heaviness. I noticed my pores look a bit more refined and my skin feels smoother overall. It layers really well under makeup too. If you want a gentle, non-sticky moisturizer that keeps your skin hydrated, this one is definitely worth trying! (I received this product as an incentive for my honest review)

I received this for free in exchange for my honest review. I love the way this moisturizer feels. It has a thick gel consistency and glides onto on my skin and absorbs quickly. The aloe and the witch hazel definitely gives this a soothing and cooling effect that feels so good. My skin is left feeling hydrated all day long. I have sensitive acne prone skin and this does not irritate my skin at all. I don't notice a scent and the packaging is so cute.
Finally a gel cream that hydrates without heaviness. My pores look tighter and my skin feels balanced.
I really enjoy this lightweight gel cream. I apply it after all other skin routine. This gel cream is very light and cooling. My face looks refreshed and hydrated throughout the whole day.

avis.titre: I love how my skin gets hydrated
avis.texte: This gel moisturizer has a light, refreshing texture that absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy feeling. It gives the skin a nice boost of hydration and leaves it soft and smooth throughout the day. Perfect for oily or combination skin, it keeps the face feeling fresh and balanced. A great everyday moisturizer if you want hydration without heaviness.

avis.titre: A Gel Cream That Actually Keeps My Skin Hydrated All Day
avis.texte: I'm 13 weeks pregnant, and my skin has been feeling dryer and less firm lately, especially in the winter wind. This gel cream kept my skin hydrated all day without any dryness. It works beautifully under sunscreen and makes my makeup look smooth and glowing. Two friends even told me that my skin looked brighter after I started using it. I have oily, acne-prone skin, and I love that this feels like aloe gel—light and refreshing—but without the dryness that aloe sometimes leaves. My skin stays balanced and less oily throughout the day. Even though I received this as a free sample, I plan to repurchase it. It has become one of my holy-grail products.
My skin looks so beautiful using this product! such a must buy !

This product has beautiful packaging. The formula is very much a "little goes a long way" type of product. The consistency is a gel, but turns quite runny upon application. The product does not fade through the day and minimized my pores throughout entire days worth of errands. I enjoy this product and reccomend it.
My skin did not like this product. It made my skin burn and itch. Definitely not for everyone.

avis.titre: Amazing on my acne prone skin!
avis.texte: It is super lightweight and so far I haven't experienced any breakouts yet. I do see slight difference in my pores overall complexion but I would have to wait a few more weeks to see drastic difference. I would definitely recommend if you just want a simple moisturizer as an acne prone and oily skin girly!!!

When I received this product, I was super stoked and excited. I've never quite used anything like it. The way it makes my skin feel is supremely amazing and the hydration is top notch. The gel is a clear pink gel that blends in so beautifully smooth and even. My first use was absolutely fantastic and I would recommend this product to anyone. It's doing wonders for my pores specifically. I can already see a shrinking of my pores. This stuff is hands down amazing and I'm so super lucky I was chosen for this opportunity. I will be buying this again and again. Thanks so super much BzzAgent! God bless you and yours so super much!

This gel cream is a great choice if you want hydration without the greasy feel. The texture is very lightweight and absorbs fast, leaving a smooth, fresh finish. The centella extract really helps calm irritation and reduce redness, and I've noticed my pores looking smaller and less noticeable—especially around my nose and forehead

After a week I can start seeing the difference. It's very good but I don't feel it super hydrating so I apply another moisturizer on top of it. I like the results and just ordered the rest of the products of this line.

Centella my overall opinion it's a very nice product goes on good easy to use . Has no smell. Absorbs fast ..would definitely recommend. For minimizing pores. Fills cool on the skin..fills very light wait..hydration is nice .

I can't attest to any minimization of pores, despite being on my second tube, but this was a rebuy for a few reasons. One: it's very good for oily skin. Two: Doesn't pill, blends well with whatever sunscreen and makeup I put on top. Three: It's not super scented. Another Korean gel cream caused me to have an allergic reaction, I'm grateful for this basic moisturizer. And four: a little goes a long way. You only need the smallest dot to cover your face after your toners and serums in the morning, and it goes to work! That said, this price isn't it. I recommend buying only on sale or with double points -- this brand even sells for a lot less directly. But I'm glad to see it in Ulta stores now, as I started using it before Ulta even carried it and I'm a fan of the Skin1004 lineup -- simple products that really use centella well.
I love how this moisturizer locks my oils in place and makes my makeup go on easyyyy. This has been the best one for me since I come from a humid island 😭🤌🏽

avis.titre: Good product, but leaves me wanting more
avis.texte: I have acne prone oily skin that is extremely dehydrated on the daily, and was hoping this cream would help with the tightness and overproduction of oil i experience. To start off, this gel is super lightweight and sinks in very easily. It doesnt bother my acne nor does it make it worse. Since its fragrance free I experienced no irritation, and it doesnt have any noticable scent. Its lovely to apply and i look forward to using it! Unfortunately though its not as hydrating as I wanted it to be. Despite using a hydrating cleanser and milky toner before this cream, i still need to apply a lotion afterwards. Next time I will try their blue skincare line, hopefully that'll help with my skin tightness!

I use this during the summer everywhere including my neck. One area I avoid is my forehead which is always oily. Makes a barrier which protects my my skin from irritation. Would recommend hyaluronic acid underneath for best results.

I am in my early 40s and live in an area with oppressive humidity all summer. My skin ranges from normal leaning dry in the winter to combo in the summer. This is a lovely, affordable gel cream that sits nicely under both sunscreen and makeup while you can drink the air outside. Its not terribly moisturizing but also doesnt clog pores.

I love other products in the Centella line, so I wanted to love this one, but it just didn't agree with my skin. It wasn't quite hydrating enough and still left me very oily at the end of the day, though slightly less than normal. The kicker was the severe, full face fungal acne breakout I got after two uses, despite having FA safe ingredients.

While this product does feel very nice, it did not help my oily skin. By mid-day, my face was an oil slick and by the end of the day I had to go wash my face because it felt so gross. Definitely does not combat oiliness.

avis.titre: For what it is, it's good.
avis.texte: I'm mid 30s, combo oily skin, fungal acne/seb derm sufferer. I was looking for a daytime moisturizer because I prefer mineral sunscreens and wanted something light underneath my drying sunscreen. Keeping in mind that this moisturizer is formulated to prevent acne and breakouts, it's well formulated for that. Feels like thick water, absorbs well, and gives my skin that extra dose of hydration that i was looking for. What this really is not: super hydrating, creamy, or packed with skin conditioners. It's perfect for humid conditions, plays well with makeup, and feels nice while putting it on. It is very much a day moisturizer and meant for layering with soothing or milky toners, ampoules, and/or essences. Hyaluronic acid products would go well with this. FA safe.

This is the newest addition to my skincare and i could never go back. My skin glows and loves this. I recommend whenever i complimented on my skin, which means alot to me becsuse i suffered with acne/acne scars for YEARS! Pricey but so so worth it!

This is the newest addition to my skincare and i could never go back. My skin glows and loves this. I recommend whenever i complimented on my skin, which means alot to me becsuse i suffered with acne/acne scars for YEARS! Pricey but so so worth it!
I used their other serium and this for pore minimizing and work great. Will definitely repurchase this again.

Combo girly here with blackheads in t-zone and cystic acne around my jawline/cheeks in early 30's. I use a light weight toner right after my shower (pyungkang yul) and then apply this gel. Where i normally start to see oil pool in parts on my forehead are no longer there! Its nice to layer in with your other skin care. Winner for me!
